payload.core_mechanism_summary: If n > m, output 0 immediately (pigeonhole principle). Otherwise, double loop over all pairs (i,j) with i<j, multiply absolute differences modulo m.
payload.rationale: The solution uses exhaustive enumeration of all pairs, with an early exit condition based on n > m that acts as a bounding rule. No backtracking, graph, or bitmask, so branch and bound is the closest fit among candidates.
